questions.prompt_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {设} X \text {和} Y \text {相互独立，概率密度分别为} \\ \varphi _{1}(x) = \{ \begin{array}{ll} 2x, 0 \leq x \leq 1 \\ 0, \text {其它} \end{array}, \varphi _{2}(y) = \{ \begin{array}{ll} e^{-(y-5)}, y > 5 \\ 0, \text {其它} \end{array}, \\ \text {则} E(XY) = ( ). \end{array}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\text{解法一}\quad&\text{由独立性，}\\&E(XY)=E(X)\cdot E(Y)=\int_{0}^{1}x\cdot 2xdx\int_{0}^{+\infty}ye^{-(y-5)}dy=\frac{2}{3}\times 6=4.\\\text{解法二}\quad&\text{令}Z=Y-5,\text{则}\\&E(XY)=E(X)\cdot E(Y)=\int_{0}^{1}x\cdot 2xdx\cdot E(Z+5)=\frac{2}{3}\times (1+5)=4.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \begin{aligned}\text{设随机变量}X,Y \text{相互独立，}x \text{的概率密度为}f_{x}(x)=\begin{cases}\frac{8}{x^{2}}, & x>2 \\0, & \text{其它}\end{cases},\;y \text{的概率密度为}f_{y}(y)=\begin{cases}2y, & 0<y<1 \\0, & \text{其它}\end{cases},\text{则} \\E(XY)=\left( \cdot \right).\end{aligned}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&E(X)=\int_{2}^{+\infty}x\cdot \frac{8}{x^{3}}dx=\int_{2}^{+\infty}\frac{8}{x^{3}}dx=4,\;\;E(Y)=\int_{0}^{1}y\cdot 2ydx=\int_{0}^{1}2y^{2}dy=\frac{2}{3}\,.\\&\text{由于 }X,Y\text{相互独立，故 }E(XY)=E(X)E(Y)=\frac{8}{3}\,.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{已知} \, P\{\xi = k\} = \frac{1}{k!e} \ (k = 0, 1, 2, \cdots) \, , \ \ \eta = 4\xi - 1 \, , \ \text{则} \ E(\eta) = (\ \ ) \, .

questions.prompt_html: \begin{aligned}\text{设}(\xi,\eta)\text{的分布律为}\quad\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}\hline\xi\searrow\eta&-1&1&2\\ \hline-1&1/4&1/10&3/10\ ,\\ \hline2&3/20&3/20&1/20\\ \hline\end{array},\text{则}E(\xi-\eta)=\left(\ \right).\end{aligned}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由题意知，} \ E(\xi)=(-1)\times(\frac{5}{20}+\frac{2}{20}+\frac{6}{20})+2\times(\frac{3}{20}+\frac{3}{20}+\frac{1}{20})=\frac{1}{20}\,,\\&E(\eta)=(-1)\times(\frac{5}{20}+\frac{3}{20})+1\times(\frac{2}{20}+\frac{3}{20})+2\times(\frac{6}{20}+\frac{1}{20})=\frac{11}{20}\,.\\&\text{故} \ E(\xi-\eta)=E(\xi)-E(\eta)=-\frac{1}{2}\,.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{设随机变量}X,Y \text{同分布，概率密度为}f(x)=\begin{cases}2x\theta^{2},&0<x<\frac{1}{\theta},\\ 0,&\text{其它}\end{cases},\text{使}E(C(X+2Y))=\frac{1}{\theta}\text{的}C=().
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{因}X,Y\text{同分布，故}\\&E(C(X+2Y))=E(CX)+2E(CY)=3CE(X)\,,\\&\text{又}E(X)=\int_{0}^{1/\theta}x\cdot 2x\theta^{2}dx=\frac{2}{3\theta}\,,\\&\text{故}3C\cdot \frac{2}{3\theta}=\frac{1}{\theta}\,,\text{得}C=\frac{1}{2}\,.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{设随机变量}X\text{与}Y\text{互相独立，且}X\text{服从区间}[0,2]\text{上的均匀分布，}Y\text{服从参数为}3\text{的指数分布，则}E(XY)=()\text{.}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\text{方法一，用期望的性质和重要分布的数字特征公式来计算。因为}\\E(XY)=E(X)E(Y),\text{又}E(X)=1,\ E(Y)=\frac{1}{3},\\ \text{所以}E(XY)=\frac{1}{3}.\\\text{方法二，用随机变量函数的期望公式来计算。}\\ \text{因为}X\text{与}Y\text{相互独立，且}\\f_{x}(x)=\begin{cases}\frac{1}{2},\ 0\leq x\leq 2\\0,\ \text{其它}\end{cases},\ \ f_{y}(y)=\begin{cases}3e^{-y},\ y>0\\0,\ \ y\leq 0\end{cases}\\ \text{所以}(X,Y)\text{的联合分布密度函数为}f(x,y)=\begin{cases}\frac{3}{2}e^{-3y},\ 0\leq x\leq 2,y>0\\0,\ \text{其它}\end{cases},\ \text{所以}\\E(XY)=\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}xyef(x,y)dx dy=\frac{3}{2}\int_{0}^{2}dx\int_{0}^{+\infty}xye^{-3y}dy=\frac{1}{3}.\end{aligned}
